title: Goodyear burning rubber and cash as turnaround plan continues
summary: Goodyear is currently implementing a comprehensive turnaround plan aimed at restructuring its operations while managing significant financial obligations. The company is focused on refinancing its debts and reducing years of accumulated liabilities. This strategic initiative is crucial for Goodyear's long-term sustainability and competitiveness in the tire manufacturing industry.
